name: Hermite Interpolation for Isosurface Extraction
definition: A method for determining isovertex positions along zero-crossing edges in contouring algorithms (like Marching Cubes) by using both function values and gradients (Hermite data) to perform higher-order interpolation, reducing artifacts caused by non-linear implicit functions.
summary: Hermite interpolation for isosurface extraction determines precise isovertex positions using scalar values and gradients, fitting higher-order polynomials to improve accuracy over linear methods.
